description: K₃Na(FeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.98 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.17 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.38 Å. Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.67 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one K and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Fe atom.
